products.title: Timberland Adventure Seeker Closed-Toe Sandal (Toddler/Little Kid)
products.description: Help them stay comfortable throughout spring with the exceptional Timberland Adventure Seeker Closed Toe Youth Sandal, formerly called the Mad River Sandal. products.title: Saucony Men's Peregrine 8 ICE+ Sneaker
products.description: Featuring vibrant Artic grip outsole, the peregrine 8 ice+ turns cold weather from an excuse to a bonus. The proprietary outsole compound utilizes wet ice tech to keep you pushing the pace without slipping, and Everun cushioning ensures you can lay fresh tracks for miles.
